## Highlights

- Uses gateway-owned workspace file catalogs for both local and remote connections, refreshing references as files change.
- Applies the shared transcript Append behavior and preserves owner-supplied tool presentation.
- Removes local inventory walking and duplicate execution-stat/outcome representations.
- Bundles möbius-gateway 0.12.0 and uses möbius 0.12.0, including GPT-6 Astra support.

## Upgrade

- Requires a protocol 67 gateway. Update the gateway and Apple app together with this CLI.
